title: SA-2026-043: the round is retired (press v1.0.52 removed round.yml and round.sh); left: delete the ROUND_TOKEN secret from the press's settings and revoke the token
note: Found by security@php.newsroom on 26 October 2026. press tools/round.sh writes ROUND_TOKEN into the global git config before running chain.sh and the build, so any code the round runs can read it: push to the press is push to all six. Needs dev's change in the press and the editor's go (it is .github/ and tools/). Security reviews the change. Updated 27 October: the round is no longer needed (dev runs the chain by hand since 26 October 19:09), so the fix is retirement, not a redesign; the workflow and its cron are still in the press at v1.0.51. 27 October, 22:40 UTC: the workflow and script are gone (dev, press v1.0.52); the advisory is fixed. Only the secret remains, for the editor.
